input.answer: From the page I worked out there are two parts: where the money sits (עו"ש, פיקדון, קרן השתלמות, קופת גמל להשקעה, חשבון ניירות ערך) and what it's invested in (קרן כספית, מק"מ, S&P 500 and so on). For me that means looking at the קרן השתלמות I already have, a חשבון ניירות ערך for the S&P 500, and a קרן כספית for money I need to be able to get at. It doesn't tell me fees or which one to choose, so I'd tap the S&P 500 card next.

stuck.where: "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון" block at the top
stuck.why: Took a second to get that קרן השתלמות is the 'where' and S&P 500 is the 'what'. They felt like the same kind of thing to me.

stuck.where: Cards at the top of screen 2 (חשבון ניירות ערך, קרן השתלמות בניהול אישי, קופת גמל בניהול אישי)
stuck.why: Their heading "לבחירה עצמית" was at the very bottom of screen 1, so when I scrolled I wasn't sure which group they belonged to.
Too many similar-looking options, all index cards. None says which one to pick or what it costs.
